name: Myth Evo Dragon D5
description: A dragon reborn through myth and evolution. Each revolution fuels its ancient power, unleashing catastrophic force that grows stronger the longer it spins.

ability.name: Draconic Ascension
ability.description: Myth Evo Dragon D5 channels its mythic evolution — every Special hit has a 70% chance to grant a permanent +15 ATK stack (max 3 stacks). On the third stack, Dragon Surge detonates: deal 60 true damage and reset stacks.

special_move.name: Mythic Dragon Fang
special_move.description: The Dragon awakens — five slashing strikes from evolved claws, each charged with ancient mythic energy!
flavour_texts: 🐉 **Mythic Dragon Fang** — five fangs of the ascended dragon tear through the heavens!
